name: Brine Archdragon

skills.name: Settlement Lore (one settlement the dragon controls)

generalAbilities.name: Aquatic Echolocation
generalAbilities.description: A brine dragon can use their hearing as a precise sense at the listed range, but only underwater.

savenote: +2 status to all saves vs. primal

defensiveAbilities.name: Decompression Sickness
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. After the dragon uses their Crushing Breath, the pressure of the depths surrounds them for 1 round. Any creature that leaves the aura during this time must succeed at a DC 39 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become dizzy and unbalanced from the sudden change in pressure, treating all squares as difficult terrain until the end of their next turn. Incorporeal creatures are immune to this aura.

defensiveAbilities.name: Regent's Glower
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The dragon is critically hit with a melee attack

Effect The dragon focuses their weighty gaze upon their assailant, filling their foe with dread. The triggering creature takes 9d8 Mental Damage damage with a Basic DC 42 Will Saving Throw save. Any creature who fails the save also becomes Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Bathygenic Barrage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The dragon uses Pressurized Pool three times. None of the bursts can overlap.

offensiveAbilities.name: Benthic Bite
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature who takes damage from a brine dragon's jaws Strike must succeed at a DC 39 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Enfeebled 3 for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crushing Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon spews a 120ft Type:line of pressurized water that deals 21d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage with a Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save. A creature that fails the save is also Clumsy 1 (Clumsy 2 on a critical failure) for 1 minute. The dragon can't use Crushing Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: When the dragon scores a critical hit with a Strike, they recharge Crushing Breath.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pressurized Pool
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon expels a 10ft Type:burst of pressurized water within 120 feet that lasts for 1 minute. A creature other than a brine dragon that enters or begins their turn within a burst must succeed at a DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become encumbered until the beginning of their next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tidal Surge
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon sweeps their wings, creating a 30ft Type:cone of buffeting water that deals 14d8 Bludgeoning Damage damage with a Basic DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw save. Each unattended object and each creature that fails the save is also pushed away from the dragon 20 feet (30 feet on a critical failure) and is knocked Prone. The dragon can't use Tidal Surge again for 1d4 rounds.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Arcana or Nature, DC 40
